name: ocid
meaning: Open contracting ID of the procurement record.

name: date
meaning: Date the contract was signed.

name: supplier_name
meaning: Registered business name (kept only in the access-controlled supplier table).

name: supplier_state
meaning: State where the supplier is based.

name: supplier_lga
meaning: Local government area where the supplier is based.

name: item
meaning: Item bought.

name: item_category
meaning: Broad group of the item (medical, food, fuel, ...).

name: quantity
meaning: Number of units ordered.

name: unit
meaning: Unit of measure.

name: value
meaning: Contract value in naira at the time of signing.

name: currency
meaning: Always NGN after cleaning (USD converted at that month's rate).

name: method
meaning: Procurement method (open competitive, selective, RFQ, direct).

name: n_bidders
meaning: Number of suppliers that bid.

name: delivery_state
meaning: State where the goods must be delivered.

name: delivery_lga
meaning: Local government area where the goods must be delivered.

name: delay_days
meaning: Days delivered after the agreed date.

name: quality_score
meaning: Inspection score from 1 (very poor) to 5 (excellent).

name: short_delivered
meaning: True if fewer units were delivered than ordered.

name: rejected
meaning: True if the delivery was rejected at inspection.

name: source
meaning: Raw file the row came from.

name: supplier_id
meaning: Anonymised supplier ID built from the normalised name and state.

name: buyer_id
meaning: Anonymised ID of the buying ministry, department or agency.

name: is_imputed
meaning: True if any predictor on this row was filled in by median/mode.

name: imputed_cols
meaning: Which predictors were filled in.

name: cost_outlier
meaning: Unit price is unusually high or low for this item (kept, flagged).

name: delay_outlier
meaning: Delay is unusually long (kept, flagged).

name: registered
meaning: Registered with the Bureau of Public Procurement.

name: debarred
meaning: Currently debarred from public contracts.

name: tax_clearance
meaning: Holds a valid tax clearance certificate.

name: cac
meaning: Registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission.

name: in_registry
meaning: Supplier was found in the registry file.

name: has_real_outcome
meaning: True if all outcomes on this row were recorded.

name: year
meaning: Year of signing.

name: month
meaning: Month of signing (1-12).

name: unit_cost_nominal
meaning: Price per unit in naira at the time of signing.

name: unit_cost_real
meaning: Price per unit in 2024 naira (inflation-adjusted).

name: log_quantity
meaning: Natural log of quantity.

name: distance_km
meaning: Straight-line distance from supplier LGA to delivery LGA, km.

name: same_state
meaning: 1 if supplier and delivery are in the same state.

name: rainy_season
meaning: 1 if signed in the rainy season (May-October).

name: conflict_events_90d
meaning: Security incidents within 50 km of the delivery LGA in the previous 90 days.

name: conflict_fatalities_90d
meaning: Deaths from those incidents.

name: is_synthetic
meaning: True if any outcome on this row was generated, not recorded.

name: failed
meaning: True if more than 30 days late, short-delivered or rejected.

name: supplier_experience
meaning: Number of earlier contracts with this supplier.

name: past_price_index
meaning: How the supplier's earlier prices compared with the typical price (log ratio).

name: past_on_time_rate
meaning: Share of the supplier's earlier, completed orders delivered on time (smoothed).

name: past_failure_rate
meaning: Share of the supplier's earlier, completed orders that failed (smoothed).

name: past_quality_mean
meaning: Average inspection score of the supplier's earlier orders (smoothed).

name: past_outcomes_known
meaning: Number of earlier orders whose outcome was known.

name: log_item_ref_price
meaning: Log of the typical 2024-naira price of the item (training years).
